title: Fetching and request states
summary: Keep a request's loading, success, and error states in one status value, fetch inside an effect that cleans up after itself, and watch the network pane expose a stale response and a duplicate request. You will add a retry button and then extract the whole pattern into a useFetch hook that the routing topics reuse.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
